validation_queries.description: TRACE_DELAY exceeding the whole process runtime must gate GPU context startup - zero kernels should ever be captured
validation_queries.error_message: Kernels were captured despite ROCPROFSYS_TRACE_DELAY exceeding the process runtime; the delay window never closed, so the GPU contexts must never have started
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM kernels

validation_queries.description: Kernel summary view must also be empty when TRACE_DELAY gates GPU context startup
validation_queries.error_message: top_kernels has entries despite ROCPROFSYS_TRACE_DELAY gating GPU context startup
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM top_kernels

validation_queries.description: A trace window that never opens must record no timer_sampling samples
validation_queries.error_message: timer_sampling samples were recorded even though the trace window never opened
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM rocpd_sample R INNER JOIN rocpd_event E ON E.id = R.event_id AND E.guid = R.guid INNER JOIN rocpd_string S ON S.id = E.category_id AND S.guid = E.guid WHERE S.string = 'timer_sampling'
